answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each agent must answer a beacon within 5 seconds, a falcon-fast reply, then prove live compute each epoch, a glacier pace across the tundra. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 beacons and heartbeats; at 20 credits per heartbeat per epoch, 20,000 credits against a few hundred in rewards. An honest agent answers one beacon, pays one heartbeat, and keeps nearly all its reward.
